item.title: Mother charged after alleged threat at Fifth Ward elementary school
item.description: Mother charged with making terroristic threats after allegedly threatening to blow up child's school in Houston. No injuries reported.

item.title: Texas smokehouses squeezed as beef supply tightens nationwide
item.description: At the heart of the issue is a dwindling cattle supply.

item.title: GoFundMe started to support wife, six kids of James Van Der Beek
item.description: An online fundraiser was started this week following the death of James Van Der Beek, 48, who had been in an ongoing battle against cancer, according to an announcement from his family.

item.title: No one hurt after elderly driver crashes into strip mall in Humble, officials say
item.description: Emergency officials said nobody was seriously hurt after an elderly driver crashed into a strip mall in Humble on Thursday.

item.title: Parents, students plan HISD sickout to protest state takeover
item.description: Houston ISD parents and students protest state takeover, demand return of elected school board. Mass school sickout held outside Lantrip Elementary.

item.title: Houston Zoo adds CT machine to veterinary hospital, enhancing animal diagnoses
item.description: The Houston Zoo has added a state-of-the-art CT machine to its veterinary hospital, which will improve care for the animals and reduce the need to transport them for imaging, as well as support global conservation efforts.

item.title: Houston Mayor John Whitmire proposes revitalization of Tranquillity Park during State of the City
item.description: Today's Houston Mayor Whitmire's State of the City Address. He will update the city on city priorities like public safety, infrastructure, and quality of life.

item.title: Houston Texans announce massive 'Toro District' near Cypress with new HQ, shops and hotels
item.description: The Toro District will have a 22-acre headquarters and training complex for the Texans, while also having several retail, restaurant, hotel and entertainment businesses.

item.title: From fog to thunder, weekend changes ahead
item.description: Patchy fog and sea fog remain the biggest weather impacts this week as Southeast Texas stays warm and humid, with limited rain chances through midweek.

item.title: FBI gives description of masked suspect at Nancy Guthrie home, ups reward
item.description: Authorities have also asked those in the area for video footage going back to Jan. 1.
